notes: Multi-sensor reconciliation (FM-023). The statistical gate is not configured here: fusion uses the tracker's own association gate, so it can never merge a pair the tracker would keep apart. max_fusable_uncertainty_m is the bound that stops a sensor reporting an absurd covariance from absorbing a contact it cannot locate; it constrains the measurement rather than the separation, because a flat distance ceiling tight enough to catch bad covariances also splits the legitimate 200-300m spread of this site's own radars.
